steps.title: Prepare Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Set the centrifuge to 4°C if required.

steps.title: Homogenize Fecal Matter
steps.instruction: Homogenize the specified amount of dry fecal matter in 700µl of QIAzol within a 1.5ml tube.

steps.title: Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 20°C for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 140µl of chloroform and mix well.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at >12,000xg at 4°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Recover the aqueous phase and prepare it for column purification.

substeps.instruction: Recover flow through and add 0.65x volumes of 100% Et-OH.
Transfer aqueous phase, determine volume by pipetting, and combine with 1x volume of 70% Et-OH.

steps.title: RNeasy Column Purification
steps.instruction: Process the sample through a RNeasy Mini spin Column.

substeps.instruction: Run through the column at >8,000xg at 20°C, processing 700µl at a time and discarding the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column Matrix
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Wash the specified number of times with ice-cold 90% Et-OH.

steps.title: Elute miRNA
steps.instruction: Elute the sample in 30µl of elution buffer.

steps.title: Dry Column
steps.instruction: Dry the tube by spinning the column for 5 minutes.
